heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 2—Application for international registration of a trade mark
text: This Division makes provision for dealing with applications for international registration of trade marks that are to be filed with the International Bureau through the intermediary of the Trade Marks Office.
